subject: Group Office Hours — multi-prospect slot choices and proposal
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhou <emma@lendly.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos@bytelane.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@shopkit.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Group Office Hours — multi-prospect slot choices and proposal

Hi everyone —

Thanks for your interest in a joint office-hours/demo to walk through Redwood Inference patterns for inference cost and latency tuning. We want to make this as useful as possible for each team while keeping it efficient. Would you please reply with the single option that works best for your group?

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Option A: Thu May 25, 9:30–10:30am PT (AM window)
- Option B: Thu May 25, 12:00–1:00pm PT (midday)
- Option C: Thu May 25, 5:00–6:00pm PT (evening, APAC-friendly)

If none of those work, say so and include 2–3 times you can do next week. We’ll consolidate and send a confirmed invite. Attach: roundtable-agenda (draft).

Goal: 45 min demo + 15 min open Q&A. Hosts: Ben (runtime + batching), Neha (observability/rollouts).

Pointers for replies: if you want a focused 1:1 instead of the group slot, note that here and we’ll offer a separate 30-min slot.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: internal: slot conflict + suggestion (split tracks)

Soojin / Neha — quick sync after the replies above. TL;DR: the three prospects want different windows, so we should avoid forcing one time that excludes others.

Proposal: run two parallel 30-min tracks and a short plenary for cross-learnings. Practicals:
- Track 1 (host: Ben) — 9:30–10:00 PT — quick live demo focused on batching/quantization (good for Emma)
- Track 2 (host: Neha) — 5:00–5:30 PT — observability & rollout checklist (good for Carlos + APAC)
- Consolidated Q&A (all): 5:35–5:50 PT — record and share notes

I’ll prep short decks and we can push invites separately to each prospect. Benefits: better signal for each team, less idle time. Drawback: more logistics (parallel bridges). I can spin up a second Jitsi/Zoom link; Neha can host the late track.

Attaching an attendee-grid.csv that maps requested windows to contacts — will update once Priya confirms.

Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi all — great — we’ll run the two-track approach Ben proposed. I just sent calendar invites (separate invites for Track 1 and Track 2) and attached the final agenda and the attendee grid so you can see who’s in which slot. A few quick notes: 

- Track 1 (9:30–10:00 PT) — batching & quantization (host: Ben) — Emma, you’re on this one.
- Track 2 (5:00–5:30 PT) — observability & rollouts (host: Neha) — Carlos, you’re on this one.
- Joint Q&A (5:35–5:50 PT) — all participants; recording will be available.

Attachments: roundtable-agenda.pdf, attendee-grid.csv, redwood-office-hours.ics
Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-group-office-hours
Recording policy: we will record the plenary Q&A only; tracks may be recorded on request — let us know.

If anyone needs to switch from the track they were placed in, reply with preferred alternate and we’ll try to accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Soojin
